task.summary:
Log #1.1 --------------------------------------------------------- "My Cabbages!" ---------------------------------------------------------- What did I do?
- Project Structure | Major project architecture restructing occurred, the structure attempts to follow industry / open source practices. | The restructure has allowed for removal of relative includes, includes are now allocated at the project level for portability and extenability. | The restructure in project Architecture has resulted in a major improvement in build speed.
- Timer Class | New definition, containing a float value used to prevent sprial of death from occurring. | Frame time is evaluated before returning, minimum value is returned, should frame time exceed max frame time, max frame time value is assigned to frame time.
- Motion Class | Acceleration formula is scaled by delta time value.
- CTransform Class | Lerp has been incorporated, with this the object type defined string was required to prevent the "floor" from being transformed from it's position. The inspiration for this implementation was Holmer (2024).
---------------------------------------------------------- What are the next steps?
[Things to fix]
- Without collision, gravity isn't represented well in the simulation. Here it may be time to consider te modification of the simulation to align with desired plan of space sim.
[Next steps]
- Refer to reading from prior commit.
- Begin production of project UML diagram.
- Continue implementation of gravity (maybe drag too) and particle component.
- Investigate Texture and Obj loader, find out why they are causing errors that prevents the project from being built in release mode.
---------------------------------------------------------- Resources
- Holmer, F. (2024) Lerp smoothing is broken. 29 May. Available at: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LSNQuFEDOyQ (Accessed: 8 January 2026)
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/build/reference/c-cpp-prop-page?view=msvc-170
---------------------------------------------------------- signing off, till next time, ﹒ ﹒ ' ﹒✦ ╰┈ ✈︎
